name: Alpes-de-Haute-Provence
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A departmental French PGI, called vin de pays des Alpes-de-Haute-Provence until 2009. It is meant for wines of the department that cannot apply for an appellation.
